name: ES Auction Arrow of Time v1
instrument: ES continuous front-month signal with one MES execution unit
hypothesis: Opening volume can be information-bearing when it arrives before displacement and reactive when it arrives after displacement. A time-antisymmetric volume-price statistic can distinguish the direction in which antecedent participation caused more subsequent movement than participation merely followed movement.

signal.minute_transition: for each adjacent pair i and i+1, price_change_i is close[i+1] minus close[i]
signal.antecedent_impact: sum over the 29 transitions of volume[i] times price_change_i
signal.reactive_impact: sum over the 29 transitions of volume[i+1] times price_change_i
signal.arrow_score: antecedent_impact minus reactive_impact, equivalently sum((volume[i] - volume[i+1]) * price_change_i)
signal.zero_rule: no trade when arrow score equals zero
signal.interpretation: trade in the direction for which volume arriving before movement dominates volume arriving after movement

execution.entry: 10:00 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.stop_fill: one adverse ES tick beyond the applicable opening extreme
execution.entry_validity: skip if the frozen stop fill is not adverse to the simulated entry
execution.same_bar_rule: if the 10:00 entry bar touches the stop trigger, assume the stop fills
execution.gap_through_rule: if a stop bar opens beyond the trigger, fill at the worse bar open plus one adverse tick; otherwise fill at the frozen stop price
execution.survivor_exit: 15:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

lesson: The time-antisymmetric placement of opening volume around adjacent price changes did not predict the later session. Both directions lost. Minute-volume lead-lag structure is either too noisy at one-minute resolution or does not persist beyond the opening auction. Negating or thresholding the score is prohibited.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed its development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: negating the arrow score after observing results
changing the opening window or transition lag
substituting returns, ranges, or typical price for the frozen close changes
weekday, volatility, volume, or regime filters
changing the stop or exit after observing results
